title: Ask HN: So, What Now?
description: If LLM's are solving all of math's hardest problems, and I can code pretty much anything with a prompt, why should I finish my CS degree? Are humans just meant to be prompt pushers and opposable thumbs now? I am in my second year of college. I genuinely am not sure what to pursue or how to estimate what society might need from me 5 years from now. So, what now? Do I just learn things for the sake of learning them? just for fun? Do I just ready my board to surf the coming AI Utopia(or)Dystopia?
